key_catalyst: Oil spiking above $90 on the ninth day of US strikes on Iran colliding with pre-earnings de-risking ahead of Alphabet, Tesla, and Intel reports this week
reasoning: The US-Iran conflict entered its ninth consecutive day with Brent breaching $90 for the first time since early June — an escalation of the recurring theme that acts as a fresh catalyst, pushing September rate-hike odds to ~53% and directly pressuring QQQ's long-duration AI valuations. AI leadership reversed lower intraday (Nvidia, TSMC, AMD) just after the SOX entered bear-market territory Friday, and over $5T of mega-cap earnings (Alphabet, Tesla Wednesday; Intel Thursday) is driving de-risking that typically intensifies as the prints approach. Although the market has absorbed the conflict with contained losses, the trajectory is escalating rather than resolving, and the index's core drivers are weakening into the biggest test of the AI capex thesis.
